pronunciation: vawn (rising tone, like asking a question)

example.romanization: A-mê, nâ chak vón pûn ngài.

note: The character is the same as in Mandarin, but the Hakka reading 'vón' shows the typical Hakka pattern of initial w-/hollow-sounds in Mandarin becoming v- in Hakka. 碗 is also the go-to classifier-companion word when talking about servings of rice or soup.
